findings.title: Saved CSV download evidence triggers the raw baseline whitespace diagnostic
findings.description: The six committed public CSV downloads retain the serializer BOM and CRLF bytes. A raw baseline-to-candidate git diff --check reports CR characters as trailing whitespace and exits2. Required clean-worktree git diff --check passes, and a separate command-local core.whitespace=cr-at-eol baseline check exits0. These are expected CSV line endings rather than a product defect; normalizing the files would destroy byte-exact downloaded evidence.
findings.requestedChange: Retain exact downloaded bytes and record this diagnostic and its format-aware verification; do not change repository Git configuration or acceptance policy.
